name: The upholstery incident
text: Your new hobo friend, Boxcar Lou, announces 'I don't feel so hot' and pukes all over the inside of your vehicle. All of it. Even the vents.

name: Beans for everyone
text: Boxcar Lou unpacks a bindle holding eleven cans of beans and insists on sharing. Spirits and food rise. So, later, does the smell.

name: Roadside wizard
text: Your passenger listens to the engine, hits it once with a spoon and leaves it running better than ever. They also siphon nothing, which they want noted.

name: Gratitude, folded small
text: At the next pullout your passenger hands you a wad of damp twenties and says 'lottery.' You decide not to ask.

name: Gone with the jerky
text: You stop for a bathroom break. Your passenger departs across the sagebrush with the grub box and $30, waving politely.

name: Harmonica hours
text: Three hours of harmonica. One song. It was not a good song the first time.

name: Shortcut sage
text: Your passenger knows a back road. It is real, it is short, and you are as surprised as anyone.
